Mr. B.D. Pande, Advocate for the

Mr. Suyash Pant, Standing Counsel
for the State of Uttarakhand.

2. Petitioner has challenged an inter-departm ental com munication dated
18.05.2023 issued by Sub-Divisional
Magistrate, Rudrapur to District
Magistrate, Udham Singh Nagar. By the
said com m unication, land com prised in
Khata No.0373, Khasra No.284-d,
adm easuring 1.9530 hectare, was
proposed for establishing a cow shelter.
3. Petitioners contend that land
referred to in the inter-departm ental
com munication belongs to them, as they
are Bhumidhar and, by mistake, the said
land has been recorded in the nam e of
State Governm ent under Category-5.
4. Learned State Counsel submits that
petitioner has raised a question of title,
which cannot be decided in a writ
petition. He subm its that if petitioners
have any grievance, they can approach
the Civil/ Revenue Court, as the case m ay
be.
5. Since the land in question has been
recorded in the name of State
Government under Category-5,
therefore, the Sub-Divisional Magistrate
is well within his right to propose the

land for construction of cow shelter.
Thus, there is no scope for interference
with the im pugned com m unication.
6. Accordingly, the writ petition fails
and is dismissed. However, petitioners
shall be at liberty to approach the
appropriate forum for declaration of their
right, if any. It is m ade clear that
dismissal of this writ petition will not
prejudice petitioners' right and the
dispute, if any, raised by the petitioners,
shall be decided on its merit.

( Man oj Ku m ar Tiw ar i, J.)
